text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-23, a route shadowing bug was fixed in api/gateway/router.go on the API gateway side.","The route shadowing issue only manifested for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The root cause was two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction, implemented in PR #3517 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1.","The wrong handler name appearing in the request span was the signal that indicated the bug was occurring.","The bug could be reproduced by curling the two overlapping prefixes in order.","The monitoring alert remained silent for 22 consecutive days due to this bug.","This work continued from earlier route shadowing investigation that had occurred in the same router location."]}
